lines.text: Primary care physicians spend more than half the workday inside the EHR. Much of that time isn't care. It's hunting — for what was decided, and why.
The EHR digitized paper without questioning it. One note per visit, the whole story retold every time. In a study of 104 million notes, half the text had been written before.
lines.say: The EHR digitized paper without questioning it. One note per visit, the whole story retold every time. In a study of a hundred and four million notes, half the text had been written before.

lines.text: But visits are administrative events. Problems are what medicine is about. When the record follows the problem, each visit adds only what changed.
An AI scribe that writes the same note faster just fills a broken library faster.
Stream is organized like clinicians think: by problem, across every visit. The note was never the point.
Try Stream free for 30 days. No credit card required.
